# Hylander Mobile

Hylander Mobile is a Kingston, NY food truck.

Important pages:
- Menu: index.html
- Contact: contact.html
- Email: h.rappaportculinary@gmail.com

Menu summary:
- Main foods include chop cheese, chop chicken, wings, sliders, pierogis, sides, and desserts.
- Drinks include mango drinks, water, and Gatorade.
- Sauce Roulette flavors include Plain, Jerk, Buffalo, Curry, BBQ, Lemon Pepper, and Mango Pepper.
- Cash is preferred. PayPal is available at hylanrappaport1.

Social:
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hylander.mobile
- Correct Instagram handle: @hylander.mobile
